description: List test runs (mission/compliance/standard/param) with rich filters: runType, outcome (PASS/FAIL/ERROR/INCONCLUSIVE), phoneNumber, configId, catalogueTestId, configName / configPhoneNumber (standard and param runs only: case-insensitive substring of the test name or run id, substring of the number it dials), date range (startedAfter/startedBefore), sort (startedAt/completedAt asc/desc), and cursor pagination. Use cases: "last 3 mission failures", "runs against phone +44… this week", "compliance fails in the last 24h", "latest run of the standard test called X" (use configName). There are two kinds of saved test: standard tests (listTestConfigs) and mission tests (listMissionTestConfigs). configId matches the runs of one saved test of either kind. configName never matches a mission test: if it finds nothing, look the test up in listMissionTestConfigs and filter by configId before telling the user a test has no runs. Rows carry ids, not test names: use getTestConfig or getMissionTestConfig to name one. For counts and percentages use aggregateTestRuns instead, never by paging through this list. D-11: Load tests live in a separate table — use listLoadTestRuns for their run history (listLoadTests lists the saved load tests); runType=load returns 400 here.

catalogueTestId.description: Filter by compliance catalogue test ID.

configId.description: Filter by saved config UUID. Matches runs of a mission-test config and runs of a standard or param test config.

configName.description: Only standard and param runs whose test name contains this text, or whose run ID does. Case-insensitive. Does not match mission or compliance runs.

configPhoneNumber.description: Only standard and param runs whose test dials a phone number containing this text.

cursor.description: Opaque base64 pagination cursor from `nextCursor` in a previous response.

jobId.description: Legacy back-compat filter — list runs for a specific test job.

limit.description: Maximum runs to return per page (1-200, default 50). Use `cursor` for the next page.

runType.description: Filter by run type. `load` is rejected (D-11).

sortBy.description: Timestamp field to sort by. Defaults to `startedAt`.

name: listTestRuns

outputSchema.description: Response for `GET /testing/runs` (filtered list with cursor pagination).

nextCursor.description: Opaque base64 cursor; present only when more pages are available.

items.description:
Slim test run summary returned by `GET /testing/runs`. No transcript or evidence
to keep payload light; use `getRunResults` or `getMissionTestRun` for full detail.

catalogueTestId.description: Compliance catalogue test ID (if a compliance run).

configId.description: Mission-test config UUID (if launched from a saved config).

outcome.description: Unified outcome. Nullable for historical rows pre-backfill.

runType.description: Derived at read time from testType + kind discriminators.

title: List Test Runs
